place.summary: Lantau Island functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TH. It receives notable inbound connections from Ngong Ping 360. Visitors often continue to Po Lin Monastery.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Hong Kong Disneyland
opportunity_cards.detail: Lantau Island frequently appears alongside Hong Kong Disneyland, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.
